description: This Lua script sets up an event-driven example demonstrating handling of mouse and keyboard events, with functions for drawing the interface and responding to user input.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window with size 400x400.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the interface elements including background and instructional texts.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Logs mouse press events, including which button was pressed.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Logs mouse release events, including which button was released.

methods.name: keyPressed
methods.description: Logs keyboard key press events with key and keyCode.

methods.name: keyReleased
methods.description: Logs keyboard key release events with key and keyCode.

methods.name: keyHeld
methods.description: Indicates a key is being held down.
